pauseBody.orchestrator: The assistant chat disappears from the patient app and the kiosk. Patients choose a department and book from the doctors list.
pauseBody.triage: Patients choose a department themselves instead of describing their symptoms.
pauseBody.records: Document upload is hidden and doctors' pre-visit summaries leave out documents.
pauseBody.scribe: Doctors type the consultation note themselves.
pauseBody.care: Care plans, the companion chat, check-ins and the patient follow-ups list are hidden.

orchestrator.purpose: Single entry point for patient and kiosk conversations and for agent events. Understands Tamil, English and Tanglish, then calls one agent or a tool (searchDoctors, getSlots, bookAppointment, rescheduleAppointment, cancelAppointment, getQueueStatus, getPatientProfile, sendNotification), with a safety check before and after every reply.
orchestrator.humanCheck: Patients confirm every booking, change and cancellation. Warning signs go straight to the emergency screen with booking blocked; medicine-dose questions are never answered.

triage.purpose: Asks follow-up questions that fit the complaint, then suggests a department, how soon to be seen and how sure it is, with plain-language reasons. Never diagnoses.
triage.humanCheck: Below 70% confidence the patient is offered the front desk. The patient decides whether to book.

records.purpose: Reads uploaded prescriptions, lab reports and discharge summaries into medicines, test values and conditions, and builds the doctor's pre-visit summary with a source for every item.
records.humanCheck: The patient checks and corrects every document before it is saved; low-confidence fields are highlighted.

scribe.purpose: Transcribes the consultation and drafts the note and prescription in the doctor's words.
scribe.humanCheck: Every AI-filled field stays marked until the doctor edits or confirms it. Nothing is final until the doctor signs.

care.purpose: Turns the signed prescription into a care plan, answers questions only from it, and checks in after the visit.
care.humanCheck: Anything outside the plan and every dose question goes to the doctor. Warning signs raise an urgent alert.
